),
relevant_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

)

    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o

WITH long_delivery_orders AS (
    SELECT
        fc.state,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM
        fact_sales fs
    JOIN
        dim_customer fc ON fs.customer_key = fc.customer_key
    JOIN
        dim_date dd_purchase ON fs.purchase_date_key = dd_purchase.date_key
    JOIN
        dim_date dd_delivered ON fs.delivered_customer_date_key = dd_delivered.date_key
    WHERE
        dd_delivered.full_date - dd_purchase.full_date > 30
    GROUP BY
        fc.state
)
SELECT
    state,
    order_count
FROM
    long_delivery_orders
ORDER BY
    order_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH delivery_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        dc.state,
        fs.order_id,
        (dd_delivered.full_date - dd_purchase.full_date) AS delivery_days
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_customer dc ON fs.customer_key = dc.customer_key
    JOIN dim_date dd_purchase ON fs.purchase_date_key = dd_purchase.date_key
    JOIN dim_date dd_delivered ON fs.delivered_customer_date_key = dd_delivered.date_key
    WHERE dd_delivered.full_date IS NOT NULL
      AND dd_purchase.full_date IS NOT NULL
),
late_orders AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        order_id
    FROM delivery_metrics
    WHERE delivery_days > 30
    GROUP BY state, order_id
)
SELECT
    state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM late_orders
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH long_delivery_orders AS (
    SELECT
        f.customer_key,
        f.order_id

    JOIN dim_date dd_purchase ON f.purchase_date_key = dd_purchase.date_key

    WHERE f.delivered_customer_date_key IS NOT NULL
      AND f.purchase_date_key IS NOT NULL
      AND (dd_delivered.full_date - dd_purchase.full_date) > 30
),
state_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ds.state_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ldo.order_id) AS order_count

    JOIN dim_customer dc ON ldo.customer_key = dc.customer_key

    SELECT
        s.state_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fs.order_id) AS order_count

    JOIN dim_city dc_city ON dc.city_key = dc_city.city_key

    WHERE fs.delivered_customer_date_key IS NOT NULL

      AND (
          (SELECT full_date FROM dim_date WHERE date_key = fs.delivered_customer_date_key) -
          (SELECT full_date FROM dim_date WHERE date_key = fs.purchase_date_key)
      ) > 30

)

    order_count

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) AS month,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) IN (2017, 2018)
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.shipping_limit_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.shipping_limit_date),
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM oi.shipping_limit_date)
)
SELECT 
    m2018.month AS month_number,
    ROUND(((m2018.revenue - m2017.revenue) / m2017.revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM monthly_revenue m2018
JOIN monthly_revenue m2017 
    ON m2018.month = m2017.month
    AND m2017.year = 2017
WHERE m2018.year = 2018
ORDER BY m2018.month

    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8

)
SELECT
